follow100Note: The $10.32 of 'other income' in every $100 is mostly a one-off paper gain on the Ventures fund — strip it out and the profit kept would be nearer $34 of every $100. Rows may not add exactly due to rounding.
footerNote: Robinhood does not report a separate cost of revenue; 'Brokerage and transaction' — the direct cost of executing customers' trades — is shown as the direct cost here. Net income of $573M includes $12M attributable to non-controlling interests; $561M (EPS $0.62) is attributable to Robinhood.
oneTimers: A $129M gain, primarily from deconsolidating Robinhood Ventures Fund I (RVI), sits in other income — it added $0.14 to diluted EPS and is not revenue from customers.
otherDetail: Other income of $135M, net — $129M of it a one-off gain from deconsolidating Robinhood Ventures Fund I (RVI).

segments.name: Transaction-based revenues
segments.note: Fees from trading: event contracts $156M (up 10x), options $342M (+29%), equities $129M (+95%), partly offset by crypto $100M (−38%).

segments.name: Net interest revenues
segments.note: Interest earned on customer cash, margin loans and securities lending, minus interest paid.

segments.name: Other revenues
segments.note: Robinhood Gold subscriptions (a record 4.8M members) and new services — the fastest-growing slice.

takeaways.text: Event-contract revenue hit $156M, up more than 10x, with a record 13.6 billion contracts traded. Options revenue rose 29% to $342M and equities 95% to $129M; crypto fell 38% to $100M.
takeaways.title: Event contracts exploded again

takeaways.text: Revenue rose 32% to $1.31B, net deposits hit a record $22B, and Gold subscribers reached a record 4.8M — the customer base kept growing even as crypto trading cooled.
takeaways.title: Growth with record deposits

takeaways.text: Net income rose 48% to $573M, but $129M came from deconsolidating the Robinhood Ventures fund — a paper gain, not trading revenue. Profit attributable to Robinhood was $561M.
takeaways.title: A one-off gain flatters profit

verdict: Robinhood's revenue jumped 32% to $1.31B as event contracts grew tenfold — and a $129M one-off gain on its Ventures fund helped push profit up 48% to $573M.
